verdict.rationale: Deepgram's own Twilio integration docs say the Voice Agent supports barge-in: callers can talk over the agent and it stops instantly, mid-sentence. That covers the stop-speech part of the story. Nothing documents how the conversation context is updated after an interruption or how the turn is recovered. missing for 10: documentation of context/history updates after barge-in, documented turn-recovery behavior or events, independent or hands-on corroboration of interruption handling.

support.subject: As a developer, I can rely on the agent to handle interruptions (barge-in) gracefully — stopping speech, updating context, and recovering the turn

citations.quote: That includes barge-in, the ability to talk over the agent and have it stop instantly.
holds a conversation with an AI that can be interrupted mid-sentence, the way people talk to each other.
